state: Goal `core-uri-1-2`. Its floor check `dossier-core-uri-1-2` names 12 `Core\Uri` members. Ten have all their feature proofs: `buildQuery`, `compareTo`, the four encoders and decoders, and the instance readers `host`, `port`, `path` and `fragment`. Only `parse` and `parseQuery` still owe proofs: `about.md`, three examples, one attack, and a Rust `#[test]` with their `covers:` marker. Each is already credited on the Novis side by a `.nvst` case that calls it. `Core\Uri` has its class card, so no member owes the `help` proof. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Uri'` measures each figure that is missing or stale, and it runs after `bun nv verify` has rebuilt the binary. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Uri' --no-perf` lists what each member still owes. The four readers share one Rust test, `the_four_readers_answer_what_was_written_and_null_only_where_nothing_was`, and one `.nvst` marker in `tests/conformance/core/uri-seven-readers-with-and-tostring-are-one-parse.nvst`.

items.text: **`Core\Uri::parse`** — owes about, examples, hostile and a Rust test carrying `// covers: Core\Uri::parse`. The marker can go on the existing `nothing_is_normalized_on_the_way_through`. Rewrite `PARSE_DOC` in the end-user voice, the way `HOST_DOC` now reads. `docs/examples/core/Uri/host/` is the shape to follow. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:673`

**`Core\Uri::parseQuery`** — the same owed list, and its card `PARSE_QUERY_DOC`. The marker can go on `the_bracket_convention_answers_what_parse_str_answers`. Then run the goal's check. If it is green, write `DONE` after the goal-end gates. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:776`

backlog: The cards of `scheme`, `userInfo`, `query` and `toString` are still in the old voice (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:828`). They belong to goal `core-uri-2-2` or `plain-comments`.
